nodes.summary: Uniqueness of the logistic solution on `[0, T]`: in the biological domain (`K > 0`, `x₀ > 0`, `r ≥ 0`), any function continuous on `[0, T]`, with right derivative `r x (1 - x / K)` on `[0, T)` and `x 0 = x₀`, equals the explicit solution on `[0, T]`.
nodes.title: Uniqueness of the logistic solution

nodes.summary: Wherever the denominator `K + x₀ (e^{r t} - 1)` is nonzero, `x' = r x (1 - x / K)` (all real parameters, `K ≠ 0`).
nodes.title: The explicit solution solves the logistic equation

nodes.summary: In the biological domain (`K > 0`, `x₀ > 0`, `r t ≥ 0`, or `x₀ ≤ K`) the denominator of the logistic solution is positive.
nodes.title: Positivity of the logistic solution's denominator

nodes.summary: The transit time from `1 / (2N)` to `1 - 1 / (2N)` is `(2 / r) log (2N - 1)`, for `N ≥ 1` and `r ≠ 0`.
nodes.title: Logistic transit time from $1/(2N)$ to $1 - 1/(2N)$

nodes.summary: Starting from frequency `a ∈ (0, 1)` with `r ≠ 0`, the logistic frequency reaches `1 - a` at time `(2 / r) log ((1 - a) / a)`.
nodes.title: Exact deterministic transit time
Initial value of the logistic solution

nodes.summary: Explicit solution of the logistic equation `x' = r x (1 - x / K)` with `x 0 = x₀`: `K x₀ e^{r t} / (K + x₀ (e^{r t} - 1))`.
nodes.title: Explicit solution of the logistic equation

nodes.summary: Log-odds grow linearly for a frequency (`K = 1`): for `0 < x₀ < 1` and all `r`, `t`, `log (x(t) / (1 - x(t))) = log (x₀ / (1 - x₀)) + r t`.
nodes.title: Log-odds grow linearly

nodes.summary: For `r > 0` and `0 < x₀ < K` the logistic solution is strictly increasing, so the transit time of `logistic_transitTime` is the unique time at which `1 - a` is reached.
nodes.title: Logistic solution is strictly increasing

nodes.summary: For `r > 0` and `x₀ > 0`, `x(t) → K` as `t → ∞` (the identity needs no sign condition on `K`; biologically `K > 0`).
nodes.title: Convergence to the carrying capacity

nodes.summary: For fixed `r`, `x₀`, `t`, the logistic solution tends to the exponential-growth solution `x₀ e^{r t}` as the carrying capacity `K → ∞`.
nodes.title: Exponential limit

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
